entities.name: Query protein UbiE
observations: 254 aa; calculated molecular mass 28.79 kDa and pI 5.50.
Contains Pfam Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25) at residues 21–249 with i-Evalue 7.4e-85.
Has additional methyltransferase-family Pfam matches spanning much of the sequence.
Shows 57.9–58.2% identity and approximately 95–96% query coverage to reviewed bacterial UbiE proteins.
Likely soluble enzyme; sequence has no evident long hydrophobic transmembrane segment.
Functional assignment is supported primarily by strong homology and domain evidence, not direct experiment on this sequence.

entities.name: UbiE
observations: UbiE is a SAM-dependent C-methyltransferase in bacterial ubiquinone and menaquinone biosynthesis.
Reviewed homolog annotations include EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201.
Reported reactions methylate demethylmenaquinol or a polyprenyl benzoquinol intermediate, using S-adenosyl-L-methionine and producing S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Associated GO biological processes include menaquinone biosynthesis and aerobic respiration.

entities.name: Quinone biosynthesis
observations: The query protein is inferred to participate in bacterial quinone/cofactor biosynthesis, especially the methylation step of menaquinone and possibly ubiquinone production.
Exact branch usage depends on organismal context and cannot be established from sequence alone.
